universal.name: Universal Studios Hollywood
universal.price_text: ≈ $109–149 one-day ticket; check date pricing online
universal.hours: Usually 09:00–20:00, varies by season · check on the day
universal.tip: Buy tickets online in advance and arrive at opening. The Studio Tour is the classic ride.

hollywood-sign.name: Hollywood Sign
hollywood-sign.tip: Best free view is from Lake Hollywood Park or the Griffith Observatory terrace. Do not hike to the letters.
hollywood-sign.best: Morning or late afternoon for clear light

griffith.name: Griffith Observatory
griffith.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 10:00–22:00 · closed Monday · check on the day
griffith.tip: Go at sunset for the city view, then stay for the free exhibits. Parking fills fast.

santa-monica-pier.name: Santa Monica Pier
santa-monica-pier.price_text: Free to walk · rides cost extra
santa-monica-pier.tip: Walk to the end for the ocean view and watch the fishermen. Bring a jacket, it is breezy.

walk-of-fame.name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
walk-of-fame.tip: Walk the stretch near the Chinese Theatre. Expect crowds and costumed characters asking for tips.

chinese-theatre.name: TCL Chinese Theatre
chinese-theatre.hours: Forecourt open daily · tour times vary
chinese-theatre.tip: Look for the hand and footprints in the forecourt. Skip the tour unless you love film history.

getty.name: The Getty Center
getty.hours: Tue–Sun 10:00–17:30 · closed Monday · check on the day
getty.tip: Parking is the only cost. The garden and city views are as good as the art.

venice-beach.name: Venice Beach
venice-beach.tip: Walk the Ocean Front Boardwalk to see the skate park and street performers. Keep valuables close.

caltech.name: California Institute of Technology (Caltech)
caltech.tip: A quiet, leafy campus in Pasadena. Combine with Old Town Pasadena for lunch.

dolby.name: Dolby Theatre
dolby.hours: Tours daily, times vary · check on the day
dolby.tip: It hosts the Oscars. The exterior and mall are free; the tour is optional.

golf-n-stuff.name: Golf N' Stuff (Norwalk)
golf-n-stuff.price_text: ≈ $10–15 per mini-golf round; check on the day
golf-n-stuff.tip: Classic family mini-golf with two courses. Good stop if you are driving through Norwalk.

grand-central-market.name: Grand Central Market
grand-central-market.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–21:00 · check on the day
grand-central-market.tip: Come hungry and try several stalls. Busy at lunch on weekdays.

hollywood-bowl.name: Hollywood Bowl
hollywood-bowl.tip: Bring a picnic and a jacket. Book tickets early for popular nights.

irises.name: Irises
irises.hours: Same as Getty Center · closed Monday
irises.tip: Van Gogh's painting hangs at the Getty Center. Check the room on arrival.

johns-pizza.name: John's Incredible Pizza Company (Carson)
johns-pizza.price_text: ≈ $15–25 buffet plus games; check on the day
johns-pizza.tip: Buffet plus arcade rides — a good rainy-day family stop near Carson.

la-la-land.name: La La Land filming spots
la-la-land.price_text: Free self-guided · guided tours cost extra
la-la-land.tip: The Griffith Observatory and Angels Flight appear in the film. Do a self-guided walk.

la-zoo.name: Los Angeles Zoo
la-zoo.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
la-zoo.tip: Big and hilly — wear comfortable shoes and start early before the heat.

pacific-park.name: Pacific Park
pacific-park.price_text: Free to enter · ride wristband ≈ $40–50; check on the day
pacific-park.hours: Rides usually 11:00–21:00 · check on the day
pacific-park.tip: The solar-powered Ferris wheel is the icon. Buy a wristband only if you ride a lot.

panda-express.name: Panda Express
panda-express.tip: Fast, cheap Chinese-American chain — handy near Hollywood Boulevard.

pretty-woman.name: Pretty Woman filming spots
pretty-woman.tip: The Beverly Wilshire hotel and Rodeo Drive feature in the film. Walk Rodeo Drive nearby.

rose-bowl.name: Rose Bowl
rose-bowl.price_text: Free to walk outside · event tickets vary
rose-bowl.hours: Stadium on event days · grounds open daytime
rose-bowl.tip: Famous for the New Year's Day game and the flea market. Check the event calendar.

santa-monica-beach.name: Santa Monica Beach
santa-monica-beach.tip: Wide sand with a paved path for walking or biking to Venice. Water is cool year-round.

rodeo-drive.name: Rodeo Drive walk
rodeo-drive.tip: Window-shop the luxury boutiques and people-watch. Best on a weekday.

venice-canals.name: Venice Canals walk
venice-canals.tip: Quiet canals and bridges a short walk from the beach crowds. Go in the morning.

runyon-canyon.name: Runyon Canyon hike
runyon-canyon.tip: Popular easy-to-moderate hike with city views. Bring water and sun protection.

angels-flight.name: Angels Flight Railway
angels-flight.price_text: ≈ $1 one way; check on the day
angels-flight.tip: Short historic funicular ride in Downtown. Combine with Grand Central Market.

last-bookstore.name: The Last Bookstore
last-bookstore.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–20:00 · check on the day
last-bookstore.tip: Big used-book store with a famous book tunnel upstairs. Good Downtown stop.

melrose-trading.name: Melrose Avenue walk
melrose-trading.tip: Street art, vintage shops and cafes. Walk the stretch near Fairfax.
